notes: Access: Claude-in-Chrome only, own tab, no HTTP client. Loaded https://www.homesrus.ae/en/ and ran same-origin fetch() from that page context for every category page; parsed the SSR HTML with regex for <h1> and the Magento layered-nav toolbar paragraph (class=toolbar-amount, 'Items X - Y of N results for <Category>'). Zero 403s / challenges / rate limits; robots.txt names no Claude agent (generic '*' group, crawl-delay 10) and only disallows query-string URLs, checkout, catalogsearch and /brands/ - all category paths used here are clean paths. Platform is Magento 2 (Lals Group). Per brief I did NOT use any categoryList.product_count API - every qty is the rendered toolbar header of the category page itself. Counts were stable across two reads of the department pages (Furniture 1655, Sofas & Chairs 375, Living 724, Bedroom 345 on both reads) and vary correctly per category. Tree source = union of (a) the homepage mega-menu, (b) /en/sitemap.xml -> media/hru/sitemap-1-1.xml (5725 URLs, 110 under /furniture), and (c) each category page's own child-link block. (c) added nodes missing from the nav: Living>Coffee & Side Tables' children Coffee Tables and Side & End Tables, Bedroom>Beds' size children, Wardrobe door-count children, Baby & Kids>cribs, Bedroom>bed-base-headboard, Living>screens-partitions, Living>console/storage/tables aliases. TRAP 2 (bad slug serves a plausible wrong number) is endemic here: every 'size/seater/door-count' sub-node returns HTTP 200 with its own <h1> but serves the PARENT's product set and the parent's total - bed sizes all read '93 results for Beds', wardrobe door counts all read '22 results for Wardrobes', dining-table seaters all read '92 results for Dining Tables'. Those were therefore NOT recorded and their parents were kept as leaves (documented per row). Exceptions: /bedroom/beds/double-beds/ does return its own set (6 results for Double Beds) and /bedroom/beds/super-king-sized-bed/ returns 0; both are inconsistent with their siblings so the whole size layer was dropped rather than partially recorded. Dead nodes that 302 to the homepage (not recorded at all): /furniture/sofa-chairs/sofa-sets/, /furniture/living/screens-partitions/, /furniture/baby-kids/cribs/, /furniture/bedroom/bed-base-headboard/, /household/bath-laundry/bathroom-furniture/. Alias/duplicate URLs collapsed: /furniture/sofas/ (canonical) = /furniture/sofa-chairs/ = /furniture/living/sofa-chairs/ (all 'Sofas & Chairs', 375); /furniture/living/console/ = /furniture/living/consoles-sideboards/ (63); /furniture/living/storage/ = /furniture/living/shoe-cabinets-shelves/ (16); /furniture/living/tables/ = /furniture/living/coffee-side-tables/ (285); /furniture/living/home-bars/ = /furniture/dining/home-bars/ (26); /furniture/junior-home/ 302s to /furniture/baby-kids/. OVERLAPPING TAXONOMY - the one judgement call worth reviewing: the site exposes the seating catalogue twice, once as the product-type branch 'Sofas & Chairs' (375: Sofas 134 / Corner 28 / Modular 52 / Sofa Beds 11 / Armchairs 126 / Recliners 23 / Ottomans 32) and once as roll-ups inside 'Living' (/furniture/living/sofas/ = 161, /furniture/living/armchairs/ = 126). living/armchairs and sofa-chairs/armchair report the same 126 and near-identical product titles, and living/sofas (161) is a roll-up of the sofa + corner-sofa split (134+28), so both Living roll-ups were dropped as duplicates and the deeper product-type branch was kept (URL-hierarchy rule + no duplicate rows). Living therefore contributes only Coffee & Side Tables, Consoles & Sideboards, TV Units & Curio Cabinets and Shoe Cabinets & Shelves. Excluded as out of scope: all of /furniture/mattress/ and its size children plus mattress toppers/protectors and /baby-kids/mattress (bedding, per brief); /baby-kids/kids-bedding-bath and /baby-kids/backpacks; /furniture/outdoor/open-sky/, /outdoor/open-skys-collection/ and /outdoor/great-outdoors/ (marketing collections, S3). Checked outside the Furniture department and rejected on product evidence: /household/decor-and-furnishings/garden/garden-pots-stands/ (h1 'Plant Stands', 117 - products are wicker/bamboo/seagrass/metal plant and flower stands filed under Garden Decor, i.e. planter accessories, not furniture) and /household/bath-laundry/bathroom-storage/racks-cabinets/ (h1 'Racks & Cabinets', 34 - products are wall hooks, over-the-door organisers, towel rails and plastic drawer organisers = standalone storage/bathroom accessories). Kids Playroom & Study was product-checked and is genuine furniture (study desks, bookcases, chairs).
